reason: The method relies on intraday order flow, pre-market imbalances, LRP halts and rapid scalping that cannot be approximated on daily bars.
style: Day trading meme stocks via imbalances and halts

universe.description: High-volume meme/SPAC stocks with news catalysts (e.g. DWAC)

setup.rule: Identify large pre-market buy imbalance at 9:25 ET
setup.quote: there was a million share imbalance

setup.rule: Stock gapping up strongly from prior close with momentum
setup.quote: the stock has capped up to 70 77

entry.rule: Buy into pre-market imbalance or at LRP before halt expecting continuation
entry.quote: i'm gonna buy so at about 9 25 eastern time ... i start buying

entry.rule: Add at LRP during halt window if buying pressure visible
entry.quote: as soon as i hit the lrps ... i'm just gonna go with the trend so i bought

stop.rule: Tight mental stop or delta order 2-3 points against if wrong on gap
stop.quote: if this goes against me two or three points i'm out

exits.rule: Take profits into strength or at open print after gap
exits.quote: i was taking profits as it was going up also i had some orders to sell on open

exits.rule: Exit long after large gap up halt re-open
exits.quote: i'm actually thinking of okay i'm going to short the print

sizing.rule: Limit size to 4-6k shares on imbalance trades; take what fills at LRP
sizing.quote: i didn't want to be more than four or five thousand shares

market_filter.rule: Trade only when pre-market activity and imbalances are extreme (meme/SPAC frenzy)
market_filter.quote: waking up at like 5 30 or 5 in the morning was a given now because there was so much activity happening pre-market

ambiguities.issue: No explicit rules given for exact imbalance size threshold or LRP % move
ambiguities.assumption: Assumes large visible imbalances (>1M shares) and 5%+ LRP moves on volatile names
